title: Never any trouble over integration
summary: He had no trouble on the road, more with fellow band members.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Yeah. Gus, you never -- integration and all that, you never had any trouble of any kind. All went pretty nice?
Not that I know of, not really.
Not a lot of people will say that, either.
I had more trouble with my own group than --
Yeah, fussing and fighting and maybe
Yeah, fancy that. That's nice, that's very nice, isn't it, because not a lot of people are going to say that.
